hypothesis: Affine uniform base-color UV transform commutes with perspective interpolation; execute trigonometry and affine arithmetic per vertex instead of per fragment. Sampler/mips/geometry/quality settings unchanged.
eligibility: Ordinary built-in base-color-only texture path with exactly matching input.uv uses; no uv1, skin/morph or material extensions. Fallback retains fragment transform.
numericalScope: f32 interpolation can differ for arbitrary transformed UVs; require exact ordinary and paired rasters in all held controlled views. No general bitwise equivalence claim.
qualityGate: Exact held ordinary/paired images, no sample/draw/quality reduction.
performanceGate: >=10% lower median queue versus contemporary Three in both orders beyond drift; no E2E regression versus owner or Fresnel-only.
